text:
Plan: Northline from Nov 25, Orbit from Dec 25, Northline from Feb 14, Orbit from Mar 14, Tidewell from Apr 14. It covers 131 of the 181 (episode, follower) pairs and costs $54.95. This is the best plan I found by comparing the main ways to arrange the months, not a proven optimum.

**Why the schedule is so constrained**
- From Nov 1 to Nov 10, Orbit and Kestrel+ are both already paid. That breaks the one-service limit, so nothing new can have access on those days.
- From Nov 11 to Nov 24, Orbit's already-paid access uses the one slot. The first new period can start Nov 25.
- From then on only one service can be active at a time, in one-month blocks. Kestrel+ and Lumen have nothing anyone follows.
- Northline must be active on some day from Feb 11 to Feb 14, or Leah misses all 9 episodes of The Quiet Lantern. So the early part of the plan can hold only two months, and the gap from Jan 25 to Feb 14 is too short for a third.

**The plan**

| Period | What it covers | Pairs |
|---|---|---|
| Northline, Nov 25 – Dec 25 | The Salt Archive for Ines and Tom; Northern Lantern (film) for all three | 15 |
| Orbit, Dec 25 – Jan 25 | Most of The Copper Signal and The Salt Garden | 22 |
| Northline, Feb 14 – Mar 14 | The Quiet Lantern (all 27); The Northern Orchard (all 6); The Amber Archive (all except Leah's episode 1) | 50 |
| Orbit, Mar 14 – Apr 14 | The Salt Orchard for all three (30); The Crooked Kingdom for Ines (8) | 38 |
| Tidewell, Apr 14 – May 14 | The Paper Garden episodes 8–10 for Tom | 3 |

Orbit's already-paid access also covers The Copper Signal episode 1 for all three (3 pairs).

**What is missed (50 pairs)**
- The Salt Archive for Leah (6): impossible, since her window (Nov 12–15) falls while only Orbit can be active.
- The Copper Signal episodes 2–5 for Leah (4) and The Salt Garden episodes 1, 2 and 8 for Leah (3).
- The Amber Archive episode 1 for Leah (1).
- The Crooked Kingdom for Leah (8): her window is Feb 22–25, which clashes with the Northline month.
- The Copper Atlas on Marquee for Ines (12).
- The Salt Ferry for Tom (9) and The Paper Garden episodes 1–7 for Tom (7).

**Alternatives compared**
- Six back-to-back months starting Nov 25: at most 120 of the pairs counted above.
- Covering Leah's Crooked Kingdom window (Feb 22–25) with Orbit: 111.
- Two early Orbit months instead of Northline then Orbit: fewer pairs.

The cost is 1199 + 1099 + 1199 + 1099 + 899 = 5495 cents.
